cases.mission: Cancel a clay golem and reach the source kill path controlled by allow_cancel_kill.
cases.selectionRationale: The closest cancellation case is v19 cancellation against a large mimic, which reveals and changes mimic state. This reaches the clay-golem allow_cancel_kill branch and death handling.
cases.sourceTrace: At segment 1 step 48 the C recording shows “Some writing vanishes from the clay golem’s head”; at step 49 the golem dies. C records rn2(6)=0 from mon.c:xkilled at PRNG call 2228, establishing the clay-golem cancellation kill branch.
cases.cOutcome: C cancels and kills the wished clay golem; xkilled executes its clay-golem death path.

firstMismatch.details: C’s first missing cancellation-death draw is rn2(6)=0 at mon.c:xkilled (call 2228); JavaScript draws rn2(5)=4 instead. The source-specific clay-golem kill branch is distinct from the earlier mimic cancellation case.

closestEarlierCases.distinction: The earlier case cancels a large mimic and reveals its disguised state; this reaches clay-golem cancellation with allow_cancel_kill and xkilled.
The v38 wand case tests resistance to a fire effect, not cancellation or the clay-golem kill branch.
